bio.text: Genevieve Angel is the Republican candidate for California's 44th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Santo Tomas in 1992 and graduate degrees from American International University in 2007 and United States University in 2025.
She works as a family nurse practitioner; her campaign website says she has lived in the district for nearly 30 years and describes her as a healthcare executive and small-business owner.
